question: On the unchanged minimum-component ties, does the Lipschitz-corrected midpoint lower margin certify whole-component complement safety and distinguish the squares development success from its failed tie without constructing complement threshold schedules?

scope.unchanged_domain: Use exactly the ties, physical speeds, windows, dispatch and reflection labels pinned by the midpoint study. Add no speed, core, window, reference, alternate-window check, broad scan, fallback query or +7/+9 work.

assumptions: Eight common-start runners; selected reference 0; threshold 1/8; strict blocking means distance below 1/8; equality is safe. Positive lonely duration and isolated equality remain separate.

candidate.component: For each tied eligible base pair reconstruct every positive component I=(l,r) of its two strict blocking sets and set t_I=(l+r)/2.
candidate.complement_lower_margin: For complement speed v define L(v,I)=distance(v*t_I,Z)-1/8-v*(r-l)/2.
candidate.lemma: Distance to the nearest integer is 1-Lipschitz. Hence for every t in the closure of I, distance(v*t,Z)-1/8 is at least L(v,I). Therefore L(v,I)>=0 certifies v is nonblocking throughout I, including equality endpoints.
candidate.pair_score: Take the minimum L(v,I) over both complement speeds and all positive components.
candidate.choice: Among minimum-component ties maximize the pair score, breaking exact score ties by physical-speed lexicographic order.
candidate.certificate: A selected pair with score >=0 certifies the full compound containment B_a intersect B_b subset Safe_c intersect Safe_d without a complement threshold schedule or containment query. A selected negative score is inconclusive, not a failure of containment or loneliness.
candidate.query_budget: No fallback pair, containment query, endpoint rescue, alternate window or post-result retuning. Postselection threshold schedules are allowed only as a separately charged audit after all scores, choices and certificate outcomes are immutable.

frozen_tests.development: Does the corrected rule select and certify {25,121}, while refusing to certify failed {25,169}? Preserve either failure or unexpected certification exactly.
frozen_tests.controls: Apply the unchanged rule to every tied Fibonacci label and strict_16. Record certifications and negative/inconclusive outcomes without modifying the rule.
frozen_tests.dispatch: doubling_112 exits on its archived positive pair-only bound before tie scoring. tight_13 has no eligible duration pair and retains isolated equality t=3/8 separately.
frozen_tests.all_tied_audit: After freezing candidate outcomes, compare every tied pair score sign with exact archived containment. Report sufficient-certificate true positives, negative-score containing pairs, and any impossible nonnegative-score false positive as an implementation-or-lemma defect. Reflections are not independent examples.

information_contract.allowed_preselection: Record id, physical speeds, window, pair-only dispatch value, eligible pairs, potential slack, minimum component count, exact base-pair component endpoints/lap labels, component widths, prescribed midpoints and complement phases only at those midpoints.
information_contract.forbidden_preselection: No complement threshold-event schedule, violation search, containment answer, actual lonely duration, archive mechanism label or oracle answer.
information_contract.postselection_reload: Reload pinned containment outcomes and mechanism/reflection labels only after candidate scores, choices and certificate decisions are immutable.

cost_ledger.candidate: Count reconstructed base blocking pieces, lap candidates, components, midpoint samples, complement phase reductions, nearest-integer distances, width computations, speed-width products, divisions by two, subtractions and score comparisons.
cost_ledger.audit: Charge all postselection threshold-event containment checks separately; they are not part of the proposed sufficient certificate.
cost_ledger.comparison_policy: Do not combine unlike operations into a synthetic runtime score or claim asymptotic improvement from this finite ledger.

verification.primary: Exact integers and fractions.Fraction only; deterministic --write/--check modes; verify every pinned SHA256 and enforce a literal preselection projection.
verification.independent: No import of primary.py. Reconstruct base components from an independently authored exact event sweep, recompute Lipschitz margins and choices, prove the numeric lower-bound inequality field-by-field, and compare separately reconstructed containment schedules only postselection.
verification.adversarial: Attack the Lipschitz lemma, factor v and half-width, strict/equality endpoints, circular distance cusps, open-component closures, information leakage, fitted-development interpretation, reflection double-counting, dispatch, cost language and any conversion of a sufficient condition into necessity.

interpretation_limits: Squares is fitted development data; success there is not transfer validation.
Fibonacci and strict_16 are archival controls, not prospective held-out cases.
A nonnegative corrected score is a sufficient whole-component certificate; a negative score is only inconclusive.
All currently tied pair-label instances have one component, so multi-component aggregation remains untested unless the pinned data contradict this.
A failed local certificate is not failed loneliness; isolated equality is not positive duration.
Selected-reference findings do not imply whole-configuration claims.
No new existence coverage, general selector, runtime, literature or novelty claim is authorized.
AI agreement is not independent mathematical validation.
